ekabala.p: [ eka+bala ] (pu) Google Translate (1) One-strength-strength-strength. (2) A person of equal strength.
pn: Ekabala. A kingdom in Jambudīpa, whose king was Saṅkhapāla. Once the king raised a large army and Mahosadha’s spies brought him news of it; thereupon Mahosadha sent his parrot to find out what it was all about. Ja.vi.390.

CPD: eka-bala , m., a single power; nâhaṃ . . . aññaṃ ~ am pi samanupassāmi, D lll 78, 28 .

ekabandhana.p: [ eka + bandhana ] (na) Google Translate (1) A bond. (2) One - Composition - Cracked area to form. (3) One-group-affiliated. (4) One stalk.

R:
ekabandhana：ဧက-ဗန္ဓန （တိ）
တစ်ဖွဲ့တည်းရှိသည်။
CPD: eka-bandhana , n. and mfn., 1. ( n. ) a single bind- ing, bondage; 2. ( mfn. ) mended in one place; — 1. nâhaṃ . . . aññaṃ ~ aṃ pi samanupassāmi, A lll 353, 17 ; — 2. patto abandhano vā ~ o vā dvibandhano vā, Vin lll 246, 17 ≠ 247, 25 = 247, 28 ; 247, 27 .

ekabandhanokāsa.p: [ ekabandhana + okāsa ] (ti) Google Translate There is a one-component, one-component space.

ekabhatta.p: [ eka + bhatta ] (pu) Google Translate (1) One-story-one-meal-meal. (Ii) (2) one-storey-in-a-meal; Who eats only one meal; he. (3) One-story alms; Only in the morning. he. (Even if you eat alms many times in the morning, you are called a person who has one layer of alms, one who eats one layer of alms.) "

R:
ekabhatta：ဧက-ဘတ္တ （န）
တစ်ထပ်တည်းစားခြင်း။
CPD: 2 eka-bhatta , ( m ) f ( n ). [ sa. ekabhakta], loyal to only one husband; reading of CeSe for ekabhattakinī at Ja lll 63, 3* ; v. next.

ekabhesajja.p: [ eka + bhesajja ] (na) Google Translate One-to-one dose.

CPD: eka-bhesajja , n., a single ( application of ) medicine; ~ en' eva akkhīni pākatikāni ahesuṃ, Dhp-a l 20, 26 .

ekabhikkhu.p: [ eka+bhikkhu ] (pu) Google Translate A monk. (In some places it means "Pissaka Buddha".

CPD: eka-bhikkhu , m., a single bhikkhu, a bhikkhu on his own; kaṭimattesu pi oghesu pavattamānesu na hi nāma ~ ussa pi pādā vā cīvarāni vā allāni bhavissanti, Vin l 292, 1 ; siyā kho pana ~ ussa pi kaṅkhā vā vimati vā Buddhe vā dhamme vā saṅghe vā, D ll 154, 25 = 155, 7 = A ll 79, 14, 21, 28 ≠ D ll 155, 22, 26 = A ll 80, 4, 9 ; atthi pana bhoto Gotamassa ~ u pi sāvako āsavānaṃ khayā . . . viharati, M l 490, 14 ; (n') atthi kho ~ u pi tehi dhammehi . . . samannāgato, lll 8, 4, 8, 28, 33 ; 15, 9 ; (n') atthi kho ~ u pi (tena bhotā Gotamena) . . . ṭhapi- to, 9, 6 foll.; atthi pana añño ~ u pi yo imehi tīhi pāṭihā- riyehi samannāgato, aññatra bhotā Gotamena, A l 172, 30 ; ~ unā saddhiṃ vissāsaṃ katvā, Sp 227, 15 ; sīla- saṃvaro nāma ~ ussa pi appameyyo asaṅkheyyo, 297, 2 ; ~ unā pi pūvo na gahito, 681, 27 ; mā maṃ ~ u pi jānātī ti . . . vihāre sāmaṇerehi pacāpetvā bhuñjituṃ pi na labh- ati, 1165, 5 ; tena saṅghena vā gaṇena vā ~ unā vā sayam eva gantvā bhikkhuniyo vattabbā, 1405, 1 ; tattha ~ ussa pi hatthakukkuccaṃ vā pādakukkuccaṃ vā . . . n' atthi, Sv 42, 20 = Spk l 276, 28 ; ~ ussa hi . . . dve upāhana- saṃghāṭā ca vaṭṭanti, Sv 82, 20 ( cf. ekassa bhikkhussa . . . vaṭṭanti, 82, 25 ); saraṇaṃ pana ~ ussa vā santike saṅghassa vā . . . gahitaṃ gahitam eva hoti, 304, 26 ; ~ unā pi na kiñci gahitaṃ, 601, 6 ; ~ usmiṃ pi hi agārave kate saṅghe kato yeva hoti, Ps lV 41, 29 ; evaṃ ~ ussa nānāpaccavekkhanā hoti, V 106, 21 ; ~ ussa pi pattena vā cīvarena vā saṅgahaṃ nâkāsi, Ud-a 95, 17 ; uyyāne ca magge ca ~ ussā pi nikkhamanokāso nâhosi, Ja l 84, 11 ; ~ uṃ pi appaṭippharitvā vacca-kuṭiyaṃ vāsaṃ kappesi, 162, 16 .

ekabhikkhunī.p: [ ekā + bhikkhunī ] (thī) Google Translate A nun.

CPD: eka-bhikkhunī , f., a single bhikkhunī; atthi pana bhoto Gotamassa ~ ī pi sāvikā āsavānaṃ khayā . . . viharati, M l 490, 22 .

ekabhājana.p: [ eka + bhājana ] (na) Google Translate One cup.

R:
ekabhājana：ဧက-ဘာဇန （န）
တစ်ခုတည်းသော ခွက်။ တစ်ခုတည်းသော ပွဲတော်အုပ်။
CPD: eka-bhājana , n., a single, one and the same bowl ( opp. to nānābhājana); te kulitthīhi . . . saddhiṃ ~ e pi bhuñjanti, Vin ll 10, 9 = lll 180, 14 ; chabbaggiyā bhik- khū ~ e pi bhuñjanti, ll 124, 5 ( ~ e ti ettha sace eko bhikkhu bhājanato phalaṃ vā pūvaṃ vā gahetvā gac- chati, Sp 1209, 1 ); Vin ll 124, 9 ; nānābhājanesu ṭhapite bhajanagaṇanāya ~ e pi amissetvā ( vd. -itvā) piṇḍapin- ḍavasena ṭhapito, Sp 711, 19 ≠ 1385, 9 ; 715, 20 ;' 824, 8 ; 841, 27 ; 844, 21 ; ~ e pakkhittataṇḍulesu pi ekasmiṃ pade- se bhattaṃ uttandulaṃ hoti, ekasmiṃ . . . ekasmiṃ . . , Sv 414, 15 .

ekabrāhmaṇa.p: [ eka + brāhmaṇa ] (pu) Google Translate One - Brahmin - Brahmin.

CPD: eka-brāhmaṇa , m., a single brahman; (n') atthi koci tevijjānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ ~ o pi yena Brahma sakkhi-diṭṭho ti, D l 238, 2, 28 ; n' atthi koci brāhmaṇā- naṃ ~ o pi yo evam āha, M ll 200, 11 ; ettakesu ( so read with Be; Ee etthakesu) brāhmaṇesu ~ o pi vedesu vā hatthisuttesu vā ekadesam pi yadi mayā saddhiṃ kathe- tuṃ samattho atthi uṭṭhahatu, Ja ll 49, 23 ; ~ o pi paṭisat- tu hutvā uṭṭhātuṃ nâsakkhi, 50, 1 ; esa kira ~ assā pi maggaṃ amaggo ti na vadati, Sv 401, 3 .

ekabuddha.p: [ eka+buddha ] (pu) Google Translate One God.

CPD: eka-buddha , m., a single Buddha; ~ assâpi uppaṭi- pāṭiyā gamanam adisvā, Ja l 89, 10 = Sp 1007, 3 ; ~ assa . . . devatā-sannipāto, Sv 683, 25 ; anekāni pana buddha- satāni buddha-sahassāni atītāni, tesu te ~ o pi na pari- ciṇṇo ( Be and Ee 1925 so ; Ee 1906 paricchinno), Dhp-a l 11, 5 ; — ° -dhāraṇa , mfn. , sustaining a single Buddha; ayaṃ . . . dasasahassī-lokadhātu ~ ī, ekass' eva tathāga- tassa guṇaṃ dhāreti, Mil 237, 15, 28 = 238, 7 ; — °( a)ntara , n., a single Buddha- interval, i.e. the interval between two Buddha s ; saṅghasadiso hi pāhunako n' atthi, tathā h' esa ~ e ca dissati abbokiṇṇañ ca, Vism 220, 14 (ekas- miṃ buddhantare vītivatte dissati, Vism-mhṭ Se l 406, 9 ; " after an interval between Buddhas", Ñm ) ≠ lt-a ll 108, 29 ( ad lt 88, 12 "pāhuneyyo").

ekabyañjana.p: [ eka + byañjana ] (na) Google Translate One consonant.

CPD: eka-bhāva , m., the being one, oneness; unity; tesaṃ vacanattho: ~ o ekattaṃ, nānābhāvo nānattaṃ, Ps l 37, 35 ( ad M l 3, 29 "ekattaṃ"); ekattan ti ~ aṃ, Ps lV 151, 11 ( ad M lll 104, 18 ; Ps-pṭ: paccatte upayoga-vaca- naṃ [ v. s.v. 2 ekatta]); ~ ena ( "unconditionally" ) is v.l. in Ce for esa sabhāvena at Ps lll 395, 5 ; — °-gata- pañha , m., title of Mil 63, 5 —64, 24 in Se ( cf. Ee: dham- mānaṃ ekato-bhāvaṃ gatānaṃ, 63, 10 ; 64, 19 ).
